resources.string: Privacy-first link sharing, without the tracking junk.
Share any link or text to Felis from within your apps. Felis instantly strips out all tracking parameters and allows you to immediately share the cleaned up URL.
Felis also integrates in your text selection context menu. Select text and tap "Clean link" to instantly clean the url without leaving your app!
Open the app from your launcher to read tips, manage settings, or test cleaning before sending links to others.
LinkCleaner is now ready.\n\nUse the Share button in apps like Spotify, Instagram, or Amazon and pick Felis to send privacy-friendly links.
Paste a URL and remove tracking junk in one tap.

Felis is a privacy-first link cleaner that strips tracking parameters before you share.
Works from Share, text selection, or directly from the app with clipboard fallback.
No accounts, no ads, no background syncing. Your links stay on your device.
Built as a free community project. You can inspect the code, suggest features, and contribute improvements.
Built and maintained by Michael Schattgen 🇳🇱
